Labels: teamrocket

   Data: dashboardName: TC-2942 Global - Dashboard Item - Calendar - Adding gadget to Jira dashboard

2. Click Edit button to add gadget
   Expected: Add a Gadget window appears.

List of available gadgets is visible.
3. Search for dashboardItemName
   Data: dashboardItemName: BigPicture Calendar
